subject: TDG2 patch rehash after sampler staging
body: Updated proposal after staging the combined/standalone sampler descriptor until success: proposals/tdg2-mip-layer.patch SHA256 c87816797fe04d8a54c5803dd64789b6b3cf5b0668703fc7c51faf74e8f65817; private patched bridge SHA256 e3c0434975c54fabc85ab883602faf93114a1fd70a3096f6b82a52cae910a055; base remains ae293c432144be8b5915ca5f2ff8f184d000be446c4f1c56cdfe19bee511da76. Applies cleanly with patch -p1. Harness result unchanged at 134 checks, 0 required/0 pending, release and ASan/UBSan. Also modified proposal to use view_format for sampler format-info (ClampToZero/integer class). arch11 texture_state now explicitly returns -2 under NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT; guard test PASS; active build excludes it.
